basic_info.description: Unassuming from the street but unforgettable inside, 162 Bocana sits behind a pvt shingle wall on one of Bernal's most coveted tree-lined blocks. This fully detached 1907 home has been stylishly reimagined for modern living, offering exceptional privacy & calm just a block from Cortland. Set back from the street, it opens to a tranquil front yard & expansive deckyour own outdoor lounge for morning coffee, evening cocktails, or effortless weekend entertaining.  W/ clean lines & warm oak floors throughout, every detail has been designed to maximize space & natural light. The main level features an open floor plan that connects a modern kitchen & dining area to a bright living room w/ smart, built-in storage. Two bedrooms share a full bathroom w/ a shower over tub, & a laundry closet adds everyday convenience.  The primary suite occupies the entire top floor, offering a true retreat w/ a custom-built walk-in closet, en-suite bath featuring a double vanity, terrazzo tile, & step-in shower. It opens to a pvt wraparound deck w/ sweeping southern views, including iconic Sutro Tower. The highlight? A barrel sauna, turning your daily routine into a personal spa experience.  Just moments from Cortland's vibrant dining & shopping scene, along w/ easy freeway connections.
